exposure: socio-economic status (Scottish Index of Multiple Deprivation, education status, household tenure)
cohort: The study included 4.62 million people in Scotland who were enumerated in the 2001 Census.
finding: Many ethnic minority groups in Scotland showed relatively lower age-adjusted mortality rate ratios compared to the White Scottish majority, an advantage that was diminished but not eliminated after adjusting for socio-economic factors and country of birth.
